summary: This code creates a visual diagram showing a class hierarchy using pydot, which is a Python wrapper around Graphviz. It defines three nodes (Person, Student, and Teacher), adds them to a directed graph, draws arrows showing that Student and Teacher both inherit from Person, and finally saves the diagram as a PNG image file.

explanations.1: pydot.Dot() creates a new directed graph object (digraph means the arrows have direction, showing relationships that flow one way).
explanations.4: pydot.Node() creates a visual box on the diagram labeled 'Person' — this represents a class in the inheritance hierarchy.
explanations.14: pydot.Edge() draws an arrow from Person to Student, showing that Student is a child class that inherits from Person.
explanations.18: write_png() renders the graph as an actual PNG image file on disk that you can open and view.
